kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أسترئل (form X)
# أَسْتَرْئِلُ (ʔastarʔilu) /ʔas.tar.ʔi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
# أَسْتَرْئِلَ (ʔastarʔila) /ʔas.tar.ʔi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
# أَسْتَرْئِلْ (ʔastarʔil) /ʔas.tar.ʔil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
